nen.hxh.technique.ten.lore: Keeps aura flowing in and around the body instead of leaking away. It works like a second skin that softens blows and slows aging.
nen.hxh.technique.ten.effect: Reduces damage taken (10% to 25% with mastery). Costs no aura.
nen.hxh.technique.ken.lore: Holds a strong layer of aura over the whole body. It protects everything at once, but tires you quickly and is weaker than focusing aura on one spot.
nen.hxh.technique.ken.effect: Intensity 1/2/3: -20/30/40% damage taken, spending 2/3/5 aura per second. Doesn't stack with Ten and Ren defense: the highest counts. Press the key while sneaking to change intensity.
nen.hxh.technique.zetsu.lore: Closes the aura nodes and stops aura from flowing out. It hides your presence and relieves fatigue, but leaves you without any Nen protection.
nen.hxh.technique.zetsu.effect: Hides your aura and mobs notice you less (you stay visible). Aura returns 50% to 150% faster, even more standing still. No Nen defense: hits with aura deal +50%. Attacking exposes you for 5s.
nen.hxh.technique.in.lore: Hides aura completely, even during an attack. Used to catch enemies off guard; only Gyo or an En can expose it.
nen.hxh.technique.in.effect: Hides the aura of your techniques and applications from other players. You stay visible and nearby Gyo users still see it. Releasing more than In can hold leaves part of the aura showing. Costs more the more it hides.
nen.hxh.technique.ren.lore: Produces and expands a large amount of aura around the body, boosting strength and durability. It is the base of offensive techniques.
nen.hxh.technique.ren.effect: Intensity 1/2/3: +15/25/40% melee damage and -3/5/8% damage taken, spending 2/3/5 aura per second. Press the key while sneaking to change intensity.
nen.hxh.technique.gyo.lore: Concentrates aura in one part of the body. In the eyes, it lets you see other people's aura and things hidden with In.
nen.hxh.technique.gyo.effect: Press to prepare (1 aura per second): you see hidden creatures nearby. Your next action spends 10 aura and moves the aura into your body: landing a hit = super punch, right click = super defense, jump = super jump, Ctrl = super dash.
nen.hxh.technique.ko.lore: Gathers all aura into a single point and cuts off the rest with Zetsu. The strike becomes absurdly strong, but the rest of the body is left exposed.
nen.hxh.technique.ko.effect: Hold the key to charge for up to 3s. Attacking releases +100% to +300% damage and spends 10 to 40 aura, even on a miss (mining doesn't count). While charging you lose Nen defense and take +50% damage. Letting go early cancels.
nen.hxh.technique.ryu.lore: Moves aura around the body mid-fight, reinforcing the fist before a strike and the guard before a block. It takes a lot of practice.
nen.hxh.technique.ryu.effect: Turns on with Ken and moves its aura: holding right click sends it to defense (-30% damage taken, -30% damage dealt) and attacking sends it to the blow (the reverse). Each shift spends 3 aura and takes a moment.
nen.hxh.technique.shu.lore: Wraps an object in your aura as if it were part of your body. Even a sheet of paper becomes sharp as steel.
nen.hxh.technique.shu.effect: Coats the held object, at intensity 1/2/3. Weapon: +15/25/40% damage. Tool: breaks 30/60/100% faster. Shield: -10/15/20% damage taken. Other objects: +8/12/16% damage. All wear less. Switching objects ends it. Press the key while sneaking to change intensity.
nen.hxh.technique.en.lore: Expands aura into a sphere around you. Anything inside it is sensed: presence, movement and shape. The bigger the circle, the higher the cost.
nen.hxh.technique.en.effect: Detects creatures in a sphere from 5 (1% proficiency) to 20 blocks across (100%), through walls and even invisible. Only you see the outline. Press the key while sneaking to pick a smaller area that costs less aura.
nen.hxh.technique.hatsu.lore: Projects aura outward to create a unique ability that reflects the user's Nen type and personality.
nen.hxh.technique.hatsu.effect: Trains the release of your type's aura. Spends 2 aura per second.
nen.hxh.upgrade.ten_youth.desc: With Ten active, recover 0.5% to 2% of max health per second, even in combat.
nen.hxh.upgrade.ken_endurance.desc: Ken costs 20% to 40% less aura, based on mastery.
nen.hxh.upgrade.ken_iron.desc: Ken blocks 5% to 15% more damage, based on mastery (55% at most).
nen.hxh.upgrade.zetsu_rest.desc: Standing still in Zetsu, aura returns 2x faster (instead of 1.5x) and heals 0.5% of health per second.
nen.hxh.upgrade.zetsu_step.desc: In Zetsu, your steps make no sound and mobs notice you less.
nen.hxh.upgrade.in_shadow.desc: In hides 25% to 50% more aura during intense releases, based on mastery.
nen.hxh.upgrade.ren_control.desc: Ren costs 15% to 35% less aura, based on mastery.
nen.hxh.upgrade.ren_surge.desc: Ren's damage bonus gets 20% to 50% larger, based on mastery.
nen.hxh.upgrade.gyo_instinct.desc: Gyo applications cost 25% to 50% less aura, based on proficiency.
nen.hxh.upgrade.ko_focus.desc: Ko charges 20% to 50% faster, based on mastery.
nen.hxh.upgrade.ryu_flow.desc: Each Ryu shift costs 25% to 50% less aura, based on mastery.
nen.hxh.upgrade.ryu_master.desc: Ryu's aura moves 25% to 65% faster, based on mastery.
nen.hxh.upgrade.shu_edge.desc: The coated object's benefit gets 20% to 50% larger and it wears even less, based on mastery.
nen.hxh.upgrade.en_wide.desc: En's largest sphere gets 25% to 50% bigger, based on mastery.

nen.hxh.stat.attack_speed.desc: Each point makes your attacks recharge 1% faster.
nen.hxh.stat.protection.desc: Each point reduces damage taken by 0.75%. A Nen stat, separate from armor.
nen.hxh.stat.agility.desc: Each point makes you 1.5% faster when walking and running.
nen.hxh.stat.aura_flow.desc: Each point recovers +1 aura per second.
